From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the introductory call today. Attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) I promised — focused on the load/perf test milestone we discussed. High-level recap of the MAP milestone for load testing: 

- Objective: Verify production-like traffic profile and validate dedicated capacity sizing for 99th-percentile latency SLOs.
- Owner (RWINF): Marissa Cole (sales), Aditya Rao (SE) — prep and run load harness, sizing recommendations.
- Owner (FinTechCo): Samir Shah — provide traffic replay artifact (request dump or pcap) and confirm peak QPS / business window.
- Target close for this milestone: 2026-07-30 (test run and sizing recommendation delivered).
- Dependencies: traffic export, redacted PII approval, procurement sign-off for any dedicated capacity trial.

For the test itself, can you confirm the traffic shape and peak QPS? On our side we typically run: 15–60 minute steady-state at peak QPS + a 30–60 minute soak at 50–75% to validate caching behavior and warm KV cache. If you can share a sample export (we prefer ndjson/request logs or a gzipped HAR/export), Aditya will validate the replay format and estimate runtime.

Proposed test windows (PST):
- Tue Jul 28 10:00–12:00 (preferred)
- Wed Jul 29 02:00–04:00 (safer off-peak)

I attached the MAP draft and a short traffic format spec. If these windows look OK, we’ll lock them and I’ll ask Aditya to confirm the replay harness requirements and preliminary dedicated capacity estimate.

Thanks — I’ll be on standby to coordinate with procurement if needed.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the write-up and the MAP. Quick answers from our side: 

- Peak QPS: ~1,500 sustained for 20–30 minutes during peak batch windows; short spikes to ~2,000 for <5 minutes reported historically.
- Latency SLO target: 95th percentile < 150ms for completed responses (our product team will share more on tokenization and response size).
- Preferred test window: Tue Jul 28 10:00–12:00 PST works for us. We can also do Wed Jul 29 02:00–04:00 if you prefer off-hours.

We’ll need a dedicated capacity sizing estimate and a short trial quote ahead of the test — procurement is CC’d to start that thread. I’ve attached a small sample export from our traffic replay pipeline (traffic-export-sample.tar.gz) — it contains ndjson with timestamp, path, headers (redacted), and payload length. Let me know if you need it in a different format.

Also confirm any data handling requirements on your side; we’ll need to share the redaction checklist with our security team.

Samir
Samir Shah
Senior Product Manager, FinTechCo
samir@fintechco.com
